connections_path.title: connections.json path
connections_path.description: Path to your connections.json. Create it first with `db-conn-mcp setup`. Your DSN stays local and is never sent anywhere.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_query
tool_signatures.description: Cancel the statement running in server backend `pid` (find pids via show_activity).

pid.description: Server backend process id, as show_activity reports it.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Server backend process id, as show_activity reports it.

tool_signatures.name: check_database
tool_signatures.description: Test connectivity for one database (or all) — returns OK or a sanitized cause.

database.description: Name of one configured database, as list_databases returns it. Omit to check every configured database.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Name of one configured database, as list_databases returns it. Omit to check every configured database.

tool_signatures.name: check_sequences
tool_signatures.description: Find sequences lagging behind their column's max value (stale after migrations).

behind_only.description: true (default): list only sequences that are behind. false: every sequence's state.

parameters.name: behind_only
parameters.description: true (default): list only sequences that are behind. false: every sequence's state.

tool_signatures.name: close_cursor
tool_signatures.description: Close an open cursor and release its database connection. Idempotent.

cursor_id.description: The cursor_id returned by open_query_cursor. An unknown or already-closed id is fine: the call just reports was_open=false.

parameters.name: cursor_id
parameters.description: The cursor_id returned by open_query_cursor. An unknown or already-closed id is fine: the call just reports was_open=false.

tool_signatures.name: diff_schemas
tool_signatures.description: Compare the schemas of two configured databases (tables, columns, PK/FK).

database_a.description: First configured database name, as list_databases returns it: usually the source of truth. Results call it side 'a'.

database_b.description: Second configured database name: usually the copy being checked. Results call it side 'b'.

parameters.name: database_a
parameters.description: First configured database name, as list_databases returns it: usually the source of truth. Results call it side 'a'.

parameters.name: database_b
parameters.description: Second configured database name: usually the copy being checked. Results call it side 'b'.

tool_signatures.name: doctor
tool_signatures.description: Diagnose the whole setup, not just connectivity — use when something is

offline.description: Skip the online check for a newer release on PyPI.

parameters.name: offline
parameters.description: Skip the online check for a newer release on PyPI.

tool_signatures.name: dump_schema_faithful
tool_signatures.description: Produce a byte-faithful schema dump using the database's own tool (pg_dump -s).

tool_signatures.name: execute_read_query
tool_signatures.description: Run a read-only SELECT query (enforced as a read-only transaction).

tool_signatures.name: execute_write_query
tool_signatures.description: Run an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL statement on a write-mode database.

sql.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL statement, with values in $1, $2, ... placeholders. The commit must send exactly the SQL and params the dry-run sent.

user_consent.description: Set true on the commit call only after the user approved this exact statement. Not needed when the database has yolo enabled.

dry_run.description: true (default): run in a transaction that is always rolled back and report the effect. false: commit, allowed only after a dry-run of the same statement.

skip_dry_run.description: Commit without a prior dry-run. Only when the user explicitly asked to skip the preview.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: true (default): run in a transaction that is always rolled back and report the effect. false: commit, allowed only after a dry-run of the same statement.

parameters.name: skip_dry_run
parameters.description: Commit without a prior dry-run. Only when the user explicitly asked to skip the preview.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL statement, with values in $1, $2, ... placeholders. The commit must send exactly the SQL and params the dry-run sent.

parameters.name: user_consent
parameters.description: Set true on the commit call only after the user approved this exact statement. Not needed when the database has yolo enabled.

tool_signatures.name: explain_query
tool_signatures.description: Show the execution plan for a read-only query (EXPLAIN; optionally ANALYZE).

analyze.description: false (default): planner estimates only, nothing runs. true: run the query too and report real timings and buffer counts.

parameters.name: analyze
parameters.description: false (default): planner estimates only, nothing runs. true: run the query too and report real timings and buffer counts.

tool_signatures.name: fetch_rows
tool_signatures.description: Fetch the next N rows from an open cursor (see open_query_cursor).

n.description: How many rows to fetch in this batch (default 100).

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: How many rows to fetch in this batch (default 100).

tool_signatures.name: find_columns
tool_signatures.description: Find columns by name across all tables of one database (fuzzy, case-insensitive).

pattern.description: Text to look for in column names, case-insensitively: 'email' matches user_email and EMAIL_ADDRESS.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Text to look for in column names, case-insensitively: 'email' matches user_email and EMAIL_ADDRESS.

tool_signatures.name: get_database_schema
tool_signatures.description: Get the whole database's schema at once, as JSON or as a runnable SQL script.

format.description: 'json' (default): tables, columns, keys as data. 'sql': a runnable DDL script that recreates the schema.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: 'json' (default): tables, columns, keys as data. 'sql': a runnable DDL script that recreates the schema.

tool_signatures.name: get_object_definition
tool_signatures.description: Get the faithful SQL definition of a non-table object by name.

object_type.description: Kind of object. 'view' also covers materialized views, 'function' also covers procedures.

name.description: Object name as stored (case-sensitive, no quotes), optionally schema-qualified: 'my_view' or 'public.my_view'.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Object name as stored (case-sensitive, no quotes), optionally schema-qualified: 'my_view' or 'public.my_view'.

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Kind of object. 'view' also covers materialized views, 'function' also covers procedures.

tool_signatures.name: get_table_schema
tool_signatures.description: Get columns, types, and primary/foreign keys for a table.

include_indexes.description: Also return the table's indexes. Default false keeps it small.

parameters.name: include_indexes
parameters.description: Also return the table's indexes. Default false keeps it small.

tool_signatures.name: list_databases
tool_signatures.description: List configured databases with their allowed mode and yolo flag (no DSN).

tool_signatures.name: list_tables
tool_signatures.description: List all tables and views in the named database.

pattern.description: Keep only tables whose name contains this text, case-insensitively: 'order' matches ORDERS and order_items. Omit for every table.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Keep only tables whose name contains this text, case-insensitively: 'order' matches ORDERS and order_items. Omit for every table.

tool_signatures.name: open_query_cursor
tool_signatures.description: Open a server-side cursor over a read-only query for batched fetching.

tool_signatures.name: sample_table_rows
tool_signatures.description: Fetch up to N rows of a table to learn its data shape.

n.description: How many rows to return: default 10, at most 1000.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: How many rows to return: default 10, at most 1000.

tool_signatures.name: search_value
tool_signatures.description: Find WHERE a value appears across tables (fuzzy, case-insensitive substring).

value.description: Text to look for inside column values, case-insensitively.

tables.description: Only search these tables: bare names as list_tables shows them, without a schema prefix. Omit to scan every non-system table.

limit_per_column.description: Sample values to return per matching column (default 5).

parameters.name: limit_per_column
parameters.description: Sample values to return per matching column (default 5).

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Only search these tables: bare names as list_tables shows them, without a schema prefix. Omit to scan every non-system table.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Text to look for inside column values, case-insensitively.

tool_signatures.name: set_yolo_mode
tool_signatures.description: Enable/disable yolo (skip the write-consent prompt) for one database, persisted.

enabled.description: true: skip the consent prompt for this database. false: ask again.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true: skip the consent prompt for this database. false: ask again.

tool_signatures.name: show_activity
tool_signatures.description: Show current server activity: pid, state, wait events, query/transaction age.

include_query.description: Also return each backend's query text, cut to 300 characters. Default false.

parameters.name: include_query
parameters.description: Also return each backend's query text, cut to 300 characters. Default false.

tool_signatures.name: table_stats
tool_signatures.description: Approximate row counts and disk/index sizes per table, largest first.

limit.description: Return only the N largest tables by total size. Omit for all.

min_size_bytes.description: Skip tables whose total size is below this many bytes.

table.description: Only this table, exactly as list_tables shows it, optionally schema-qualified ('public.orders'). Omit for every table.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return only the N largest tables by total size. Omit for all.

parameters.name: min_size_bytes
parameters.description: Skip tables whose total size is below this many bytes.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Only this table, exactly as list_tables shows it, optionally schema-qualified ('public.orders'). Omit for every table.
